item.description: - JustNow now keeps recording while iOS Simulator is running, instead of pausing whenever Simulator was open. - If macOS briefly interrupts screen capture, JustNow recovers automatically and the menu shows “Recovering…” instead of looking like a recording permission problem. - The menu bar icon now changes whenever capture pauses for a reason other than your own pause — such as a locked screen, system recovery, or an error — so you can see at a glance that history isn’t being recorded.

- Recent-history settings that need a relaunch now offer a Relaunch JustNow button beside the relevant setting. - JustNow confirms before relaunching, closes cleanly, saves the latest frame from each display, and then reopens automatically. - The relaunch note now sits with the Memory limit setting, making it clearer which change is waiting to be applied. - Other recent detail held only in memory is cleared during the relaunch; on-disk recovery points remain available.

- Scroll through your timeline with a mouse or trackpad. By default, scroll up to rewind and down to move forwards. You can reverse this direction—or turn scrolling off—in Settings. - Recent history is now kept in memory by default. This makes browsing feel much faster and reduces disk writes. - Choose a memory limit of 256 MB, 512 MB, or 1 GB. The default is 512 MB. - The memory limit is a ceiling, not RAM reserved upfront. JustNow automatically scales back when memory is tight. Changes to this setting take effect after relaunching the app. - Recent detail held in memory is temporary. Periodic recovery points remain on disk, and on a normal quit JustNow saves the latest frame from each display; other memory-only detail is cleared. History restored after a restart may therefore contain less detail. - Timeline navigation now works consistently across both detailed recent history and more widely spaced older history. - Improved capture recovery, with fewer stalls and repeated Screen Recording permission prompts.

- Capture now pauses when the screen locks instead of stopping outright, and resumes on unlock - Added a persistent diagnostics log for capture failures at `~/Library/Logs/JustNow/diagnostics.log` (capped at 512 KB per file) - Documented JustNow's privacy stance and the local diagnostics log in the README
- refactor: remove over-engineering found by ponytail-audit by @yjsoon in https://github.com/yjsoon/justnow/pull/37

- Organised Settings into General, Rewind, Capture, and Shortcuts tabs. - Added a Rewind setting to choose whether plain drag grabs text or captures a screenshot. - Fixed secondary-display overlay sizing. - Hardened capture optimisation cleanup.
